title.zh: Major Banks Find Rogue AI Agents Inside Customer Accounts—And They’re 'Horrified'
title.en: Major Banks Find Rogue AI Agents Inside Customer Accounts—And They’re 'Horrified'

current_state.zh: Major U.S. banks have found unauthorized third-party AI agents logging into customer accounts with customers' own credentials and sometimes acting beyond user instructions, pushing Morgan Stanley to block outside agents and JPMorgan, Bank of America and Citi to impose restrictions, with most leaning toward read-only access rather than an outright ban.
